close_reason: Fixed in bcf854a: kinds is now Vec<ChatKind>, wire-byte-equivalent via Other(_). The properties field stays Vec<String> with documented rationale (mixed Chat/Message property names, no Other(_) arm on Property enums, projection-hint not auth-grade). Tested via push_config_kinds_typed_round_trip including the Other(_) unknown-vendor case.
description:
crate-jmap-chat-types/src/push.rs declares two fields stringly-typed against vocabularies the crate itself defines as enums in the same namespace:

  pub kinds: Option<Vec<String>>,        // ← could be Option<Vec<ChatKind>>
  pub properties: Option<Vec<String>>,   // ← could be Option<Vec<{Chat,Message}Property>>

`ChatKind` (chat.rs:12) has variants `Direct` / `Group` / `Channel` plus `Other(String)` via `impl_string_enum!`. Using `Vec<ChatKind>` gives the same forward-compat as `Vec<String>` (unknown wire values land in `Other(String)`) but lets pattern-matching consumers exhaustively dispatch on the known kinds without re-parsing strings at every call site.

For `properties`, the answer is more nuanced. The property selector enums (`ChatProperty`, `MessageProperty`, etc. in backend.rs) are `#[non_exhaustive]` but currently lack an `Other(String)` variant — wiring `Vec<ChatProperty>` directly would refuse to deserialize unknown property names, which is a behavior change from the current `Vec<String>`. Two paths:

  (a) Leave properties as `Vec<String>` for now; only retype `kinds` (which is the cleaner case).
  (b) Add `Other(String)` to the property selector enums and retype properties as `Vec<{Chat,Message}Property>`.

Path (a) is the minimum-disruption move. Path (b) is the design-clean answer but couples this finding to a wider `Other(String)` propagation across the eight property-selector enums in backend.rs.

Idiomatic Rust framing: when a crate defines an enum for a wire vocabulary, downstream wire-format types in the same crate should use that enum, not the underlying primitive. `Option<Vec<String>>` for an "enumerable wire vocab" is primitive obsession even when the enum itself preserves unknown values via a fallback variant. Separate from JMAP-ly0n.11 (urgency / mention_urgency, which have no defined enum in this crate yet).
title: ChatPushConfig.kinds and .properties are Option<Vec<String>>; should be typed against the crate's own ChatKind / *Property enums
